jobs.title: TEILZEIT MODEBERATERIN 60% (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
We're here to make you feel sexy, empowered & UNSTOPPABLE.

Founded in 1984, Tally Weijl has been on a crazy journey to celebrate fashion, independence, fun, love, & community for close to 40 years. Today we’re present in 35 markets with over 700+ stores, online presence, and 3m+ fans across social channels. Show us how #UNSTOPPABLE you are!

TEILZEIT MODEBERATERIN 60% (m/w/d)

DEIN BEITRAG FÜR UNSEREN GEMEINSAMEN ERFOLG

· Als Verkäufer/in berätst du unsere (Young & Golden) Kundin mit viel Motivation und Spass umfassend

· Du gewinnst neue Kunden und pflegst bestehende Kundenbeziehungen mit Deiner positiven Ausstrahlung

· Die Präsentation des Warensortiments und des Shop Aufbaus verwirklichst du entsprechend internen Guidelines

· Du kennst unsere Kollektionen und Trends und lässt Dein Wissen in die Beratung der Kundin einfliessen

· An der Kasse rundest Du mit deiner freundlichen und offenen Art das Einkaufserlebnis der Kundin ab

DAS ZEICHNET DICH AUS

· Eine erfolgreich abgeschlossen kaufmännische Grundausbildung im Detailhandel

· Du bist 100% verkaufs – sowie kundenorientiert

· Du konntest bereits Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Stelle sammeln

· Die trendige Fashionwelt ist Deine Leidenschaft

· Die Kommunikation und Arbeit im Team gehören zu Deinen Stärken

· Du bist stolz auf dein gepflegtes Erscheinungsbild

· Du sprichst fliessen Deutsch und jede weitere Sprache ist ein Vorteil

DEINE VORTEILE BEI UNS

· Wir fördern berufliche Weiterentwicklung und bieten vielseitige Karrieremöglichkeiten

· Abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einer dynamischen, offenen und teamorientierten Unternehmenskultur

· Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte ( 50%)

· Ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Mode und Spass an der Arbeit im Vordergrund stehen

· Internationale Arbeitserfahrung

· Minimum 25 Urlaubstage ( + 3 Tage Anwesenheitsprämie )

· Grundgehalt und Bonus/ Gratifikationen möglichkeiten

Möchtest du ein Teil unserer Fashion Story und ein begeistertes Mitglied unserer TALLY Family werden. Dann teile dein individuelles Talent mit uns und bewerbe dich jetzt bei HR

descriptionByLocale.it:
Siamo qui per farti sentire sexy, potenziato e ONUSTOPPABLE.

Fondato nel 1984, Tally Weijl è stato in un viaggio folle per celebrare moda, indipendenza, divertimento, amore e comunità per quasi 40 anni. Oggi siamo presenti in 35 mercati con oltre 700+ negozi, presenza online e 3m+ fan attraverso i canali sociali. Mostraci come #UNSTOPPABLE sei!

PARTE-TIME MODEBERATERIN 60% (m/f/d)

Il tuo contributo al nostro successo comune

· Come venditore si consiglia il nostro (Young & Golden) cliente con un sacco di motivazione e divertimento in modo completo

· Ottieni nuovi clienti e mantieni i rapporti con i clienti esistenti con il tuo carisma positivo

· La presentazione della gamma di prodotti e la struttura del negozio si realizza secondo le linee guida interne

· Conoscete le nostre collezioni e le nostre tendenze e lasciate che la vostra conoscenza fluisca nel consiglio del cliente

· Al checkout, si completa l'esperienza di shopping del cliente con il vostro modo amichevole e aperto.

Questo ti tira fuori

· Una formazione commerciale di base completata con successo nel commercio al dettaglio

· Sei 100% vendite- e orientato al cliente

· Hai già acquisito esperienza in una posizione simile

· Il mondo della moda alla moda è la tua passione

· Comunicazione e lavoro in un team sono tra i vostri punti di forza

· Sei orgoglioso del tuo aspetto ben curato

· Parli fluente tedesco e ogni altra lingua è un vantaggio

I tuoi vantaggi in noi

· Promuoviamo lo sviluppo professionale e offriamo varie opportunità di carriera

· Varie attività in una cultura aziendale dinamica, aperta e orientata al team

· Sconti interessanti dei dipendenti (50%)

· Un ambiente di lavoro dove la moda e il divertimento al lavoro sono fondamentali

· Esperienza di lavoro internazionale

· Minimo 25 giorni di congedo (+ premio di frequenza di 3 giorni)

· Possibilità di stipendio base e bonus/gratificazione

Vorresti diventare parte della nostra storia di moda e membro entusiasta della nostra famiglia TALLY. Quindi condividere il vostro talento individuale con noi e applicare alle risorse umane ora
descriptionByLocale.en:
We're here to make you feel sexy, empowered & UNSTOPPABLE.

Founded in 1984, Tally Weijl has been on a crazy journey to celebrate fashion, independence, fun, love, & community for close to 40 years. Today we’re present in 35 markets with over 700+ stores, online presence, and 3m+ fans across social channels. Show us how #UNSTOPPABLE you are!

PART-TIME MODEBERATERIN 60% (m/f/d)

Your Contribution to Our Common Success

· As a salesperson you advise our (Young & Golden) customer with a lot of motivation and fun comprehensively

· You gain new customers and maintain existing customer relationships with your positive charisma

· The presentation of the product range and the shop structure you realize according to internal guidelines

· You know our collections and trends and let your knowledge flow into the advice of the customer

· At the checkout, you round off the customer’s shopping experience with your friendly and open manner.

That draws you out

· A successfully completed basic commercial training in the retail trade

· You are 100% sales- and customer-oriented

· You have already gained experience in a similar position

· The trendy fashion world is your passion

· Communication and working in a team are among your strengths

· You are proud of your well-groomed appearance

· You speak fluent German and every other language is an advantage

Your Advantages in Us

· We promote professional development and offer varied career opportunities

· Varied activities in a dynamic, open and team-oriented corporate culture

· Attractive employee discounts (50%)

· A working environment where fashion and fun at work are paramount

· International work experience

· Minimum 25 days of leave (+ 3 days attendance premium)

· Basic salary and bonus/gratification possibilities

Would you like to become a part of our fashion story and an enthusiastic member of our TALLY Family. Then share your individual talent with us and apply to HR now

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Nous sommes ici pour vous faire sentir sexy, autonomisé et intouchable.

Fondée en 1984, Tally Weijl est sur un voyage fou pour célébrer la mode, l'indépendance, le plaisir, l'amour et la communauté depuis près de 40 ans. Aujourd'hui, nous sommes présents sur 35 marchés avec plus de 700 magasins, présence en ligne et fans de 3m+ sur les chaînes sociales. Montrez-nous comment vous êtes !

MODEBÉRATÉRIEN À TEMPS PARTIEL 60 % (m/f/d)

Votre contribution à notre réussite commune

· En tant que vendeur, vous conseillez notre client (Young & Golden) avec beaucoup de motivation et de plaisir

· Vous gagnez de nouveaux clients et maintenez des relations client existantes avec votre charisme positif

· La présentation de la gamme de produits et la structure du magasin que vous réalisez selon les directives internes

· Vous connaissez nos collections et tendances et laissez vos connaissances s'intégrer dans les conseils du client

· À la caisse, vous arrondissez l'expérience d'achat du client avec votre façon amicale et ouverte.

Ça vous attire.

· Une formation commerciale de base réussie dans le commerce de détail

· Vous êtes 100% axé sur les ventes et le client

· Vous avez déjà acquis une expérience dans un poste similaire

· Le monde de la mode branché est votre passion

· La communication et le travail en équipe font partie de vos forces

· Vous êtes fier de votre apparence soignée

· Vous parlez couramment l'allemand et toutes les autres langues est un avantage

Vos avantages en nous

· Nous favorisons le perfectionnement professionnel et offrons des possibilités de carrière variées

· Activités variées dans une culture d'entreprise dynamique, ouverte et axée sur l'équipe

· Réductions attrayantes pour les employés (50%)

· Un environnement de travail où la mode et le plaisir au travail sont essentiels

· Expérience professionnelle internationale

· 25 jours minimum de congé (+ 3 jours de prime de présence)

· Salaire de base et possibilités de bonus/gratification

Aimeriez-vous devenir une partie de notre histoire de mode et un membre enthousiaste de notre famille TALLY. Alors partagez votre talent individuel avec nous et appliquez à RH maintenant

Fondato nel 1984, Tally Weijl è stato in un viaggio folle per celebrare moda, indipendenza, divertimento, amore e comunità per quasi 40 anni. Oggi siamo presenti in 35 mercati con oltre 700+ negozi, presenza online e 3m+ fan attraverso i canali sociali. Mostraci come #UNSTOPPABLE sei!

STORE MANAGER 100% (m/f/d)

Il tuo contributo al nostro successo comune

· Come direttore di filiale, si guida e formare il vostro team per il successo aziendale

· Insieme al vostro team, assicurate il servizio clienti ottimale

· Sei responsabile del raggiungimento del fatturato pianificato

· Sei responsabile del rispetto delle misure di sicurezza nel negozio

· Garantisci la gestione ottimale delle merci e l'aspetto pulito del tuo negozio

· Il vostro team vince nuovi clienti con il vostro aiuto e mantenere le relazioni con i clienti esistenti

· Lei agisce come modello di ruolo e può motivare il vostro team

Questo ti tira fuori

· Una formazione di base commerciale completata con successo nella vendita al dettaglio

· Porti 1-2 anni di esperienza professionale come dirigente al dettaglio

· Le capacità organizzative, di pianificazione e di comunicazione sono tra i vostri punti di forza

· Hai una buona conoscenza del tedesco, ogni altra lingua è un vantaggio

· Sei la moda consapevole, creativo e vendite al 100% – così come orientato al cliente

· La moda è la vostra grande passione e vi ispirate alle ultime tendenze

· Sei orgoglioso del tuo aspetto ben curato

· In un ambiente veloce, rimani sempre calmo e flessibile

I tuoi vantaggi in noi

· Promuoviamo lo sviluppo professionale e offriamo varie opportunità di carriera

· Varie attività in una cultura aziendale dinamica, aperta e orientata al team

· Sconti interessanti dei dipendenti (50%)

· Un ambiente di lavoro dove la moda e il divertimento al lavoro sono fondamentali

· Esperienza di lavoro internazionale

· Occupazione pensione

· Minimo 30 giorni di vacanza

· Opzioni di stipendio base e bonus

Vorresti diventare parte della nostra storia di moda e membro entusiasta della nostra famiglia TALLY. Quindi condividere il vostro talento individuale con noi e applicare alle risorse umane ora
descriptionByLocale.en:
We're here to make you feel sexy, empowered & UNSTOPPABLE.

Founded in 1984, Tally Weijl has been on a crazy journey to celebrate fashion, independence, fun, love, & community for close to 40 years. Today we’re present in 35 markets with over 700+ stores, online presence, and 3m+ fans across social channels. Show us how #UNSTOPPABLE you are!

STORE MANAGER 100% (m/f/d)

Your Contribution to Our Common Success

· As a branch manager, you lead and train your team for company success

· Together with your team, you ensure the optimal customer service

· You are responsible for achieving the planned turnover

· You are responsible for compliance with the security measures in the shop

· You ensure the optimal goods management and the clean look of your store

· Your team wins new customers with your help and you maintain existing customer relationships

· You act as a role model and can motivate your team

That draws you out

· A successfully completed commercial basic training in retail

· You bring 1-2 years of professional experience as a retail executive

· Organizational, planning and communication skills are among your strengths

· You have very good knowledge of German, every other language is an advantage

· You are fashion conscious, creative and 100% sales – as well as customer-oriented

· Fashion is your great passion and you inspire yourself for the latest trends

· You are proud of your well-groomed appearance

· In a fast-paced environment, you always stay calm and flexible

Your Advantages in Us

· We promote professional development and offer varied career opportunities

· Varied activities in a dynamic, open and team-oriented corporate culture

· Attractive employee discounts (50%)

· A working environment where fashion and fun at work are paramount

· International work experience

· Workplace pension provision

· Minimum 30 days of vacation

· Basic salary and bonus options

Would you like to become a part of our fashion story and an enthusiastic member of our TALLY Family. Then share your individual talent with us and apply to HR now

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Nous sommes ici pour vous faire sentir sexy, autonomisé et intouchable.

Fondée en 1984, Tally Weijl est sur un voyage fou pour célébrer la mode, l'indépendance, le plaisir, l'amour et la communauté depuis près de 40 ans. Aujourd'hui, nous sommes présents sur 35 marchés avec plus de 700 magasins, présence en ligne et fans de 3m+ sur les chaînes sociales. Montrez-nous comment vous êtes !

GESTIONNAIRE À 100 % (m/f/d)

Votre contribution à notre réussite commune

· En tant que gestionnaire de succursale, vous dirigez et formez votre équipe pour le succès de l'entreprise

· Avec votre équipe, vous assurez un service client optimal

· Vous êtes responsable du chiffre d'affaires prévu

· Vous êtes responsable du respect des mesures de sécurité dans le magasin

· Vous assurez la gestion optimale des marchandises et l'apparence propre de votre magasin

· Votre équipe gagne de nouveaux clients avec votre aide et vous maintenez des relations client existantes

· Vous agissez comme un modèle et pouvez motiver votre équipe

Ça vous attire.

· Une formation de base commerciale réussie dans le commerce de détail

· Vous apportez 1-2 ans d'expérience professionnelle en tant que directeur du commerce de détail

· Les compétences organisationnelles, de planification et de communication font partie de vos forces

· Vous avez une très bonne connaissance de l'allemand, toute autre langue est un avantage

· Vous êtes conscient de la mode, créatif et 100% de ventes – ainsi que orientés vers le client

· La mode est votre grande passion et vous vous inspirez pour les dernières tendances

· Vous êtes fier de votre apparence soignée

· Dans un environnement rapide, vous restez toujours calme et flexible

Vos avantages en nous

· Nous favorisons le perfectionnement professionnel et offrons des possibilités de carrière variées

· Activités variées dans une culture d'entreprise dynamique, ouverte et axée sur l'équipe

· Réductions attrayantes pour les employés (50%)

· Un environnement de travail où la mode et le plaisir au travail sont essentiels

· Expérience professionnelle internationale

· Prestations de retraite sur le lieu de travail

· Au moins 30 jours de vacances

· Salaire de base et options de bonus

Aimeriez-vous devenir une partie de notre histoire de mode et un membre enthousiaste de notre famille TALLY. Alors partagez votre talent individuel avec nous et appliquez à RH maintenant

Founded in 1984, Tally Weijl has been on an exciting crazy journey for almost 40 years to celebrate fashion, passion, self-employment, fun, love and community. Today, we are present in 35 countries with more than 700 stores, an online presence and more than 3 million fans on social networks. Show us how #UNSTOPPABLE you are!

FLEXIBLE AID (m/f/d)

Your Contribution to Our Common Success

• As an assistant in sales, you advise our customer with a lot of motivation and have fun comprehensively

• You know our collections and trends and let your knowledge flow into the advice of the customers

• You are jointly responsible for achieving the set goals and support your team with full commitment

That draws you out

• You are 100% sales- and customer-oriented

• You have already gained experience in a similar position

• The trendy fashion world is your passion

• Communication and working in a team are among your strengths

• You are proud of your well-groomed appearance

• You speak fluent German and every other language is an advantage

• You are at least 18 years old

Your Advantages in Us

• We promote professional development and offer varied career opportunities

• Varied activity in a dynamic, open and team-oriented corporate culture

• Attractive employee discounts (50%)

• A working environment where fashion and fun at work are paramount

• International work experience

• Occupational pension provision

• Minimum 30 days of leave

• Basic salary and bonus possibilities

Are you also UNSTOPPABLE and want to be part of our unprecedented fashion story in our TALLY family?

Then share your individual talent with us and apply now to Team HR Recruitment

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Nous sommes ici pour vous faire sentir sexy, confiant et intouchable.

Fondée en 1984, Tally Weijl est sur un passionnant voyage fou depuis près de 40 ans pour célébrer la mode, la passion, le travail indépendant, le plaisir, l'amour et la communauté. Aujourd'hui, nous sommes présents dans 35 pays avec plus de 700 magasins, une présence en ligne et plus de 3 millions de fans sur les réseaux sociaux. Montrez-nous comment vous êtes !

AIDE FLEXIBLE (m/f/d)

Votre contribution à notre réussite commune

• En tant qu'assistant dans les ventes, vous conseillez notre client avec beaucoup de motivation et de plaisir

• Vous connaissez nos collections et tendances et laissez vos connaissances s'intégrer dans les conseils des clients

• Vous êtes conjointement responsable d'atteindre les objectifs fixés et de soutenir votre équipe avec un engagement total

Ça vous attire.

• Vous êtes 100% axé sur les ventes et le client

• Vous avez déjà acquis une expérience dans un poste similaire

• Le monde de la mode branché est votre passion

• La communication et le travail en équipe font partie de vos forces

• Vous êtes fier de votre apparence soignée

• Vous parlez couramment l'allemand et toutes les autres langues est un avantage

• Vous avez au moins 18 ans.

Vos avantages en nous

• Nous favorisons le perfectionnement professionnel et offrons des possibilités de carrière variées

• Activité variée dans une culture d'entreprise dynamique, ouverte et axée sur l'équipe

• Réductions attractives pour les employés (50%)

• Un environnement de travail où la mode et le plaisir au travail sont essentiels

• Expérience professionnelle internationale

• Pension professionnelle

• Au moins 30 jours de congé

• Salaire de base et possibilités de bonus

Êtes-vous également intouchable et voulez-vous faire partie de notre histoire de mode sans précédent dans notre famille TALLY?

Ensuite, partagez votre talent individuel avec nous et postulez maintenant au recrutement de l'équipe RH

descriptionByLocale.it:
Siamo qui per farvi sentire sexy, fiducioso e ONUSTOPPABLE. Fondato nel 1984, Tally Weijl è stato in un emozionante viaggio folle da quasi 40 anni per celebrare moda, passione, auto-occupazione, divertimento, amore e comunità. Oggi, siamo presenti in 35 paesi con oltre 700 negozi, una presenza online e oltre 3 milioni di fan sui social network. Mostraci come #UNSTOPPABLE sei! Branch Manager / Store Manager (f/m/d) Il tuo contributo al nostro successo comune
• In qualità di amministratore di ramo, si guida e formare il vostro team per il successo aziendale
• Insieme al vostro team, assicurate il servizio clienti ottimale
• Sei responsabile del raggiungimento del fatturato pianificato
• Lei è responsabile del rispetto delle misure di sicurezza nel negozio
• Garantisci la gestione ottimale delle merci e l'aspetto pulito del tuo negozio
• Il vostro team vince nuovi clienti con il vostro aiuto e si mantiene le relazioni con i clienti esistenti
• Si comporta come un modello di ruolo e può motivare il vostro team Questo ti tira fuori
• Una formazione di base commerciale completata con successo nella vendita al dettaglio
• Porti 1-2 anni di esperienza professionale come dirigente al dettaglio
• Le capacità organizzative, di pianificazione e di comunicazione sono tra i vostri punti di forza
• Hai una buona conoscenza del tedesco, ogni altra lingua è un vantaggio
• Tu sei la moda consapevole, creativo e 100% vendite – così come orientato al cliente
• La moda è la vostra grande passione e vi ispirate alle ultime tendenze
• Sei orgoglioso del tuo aspetto ben curato
• Soggiorna in un ambiente frenetico Sei sempre calmo e flessibile I tuoi vantaggi in noi
• Promuoviamo lo sviluppo professionale e offriamo varie opportunità di carriera
• Attività diversificata in una cultura aziendale dinamica, aperta e orientata al team
• Sconti interessanti (50%)
• Un ambiente di lavoro dove la moda e il divertimento al lavoro sono fondamentali
• Esperienza lavorativa internazionale
• Previdenza sociale
• minimo 30 giorni di congedo
• Possibilità di stipendio base e bonus Sei anche UNSTOPPABLE e vuoi far parte della nostra storia di moda senza precedenti nella nostra inarrestabile famiglia TALLY? Quindi condividere il vostro talento individuale con noi e applicare ora al Team HR Recruitment
descriptionByLocale.en:
We are here to make you feel sexy, confident and UNSTOPPABLE. Founded in 1984, Tally Weijl has been on an exciting crazy journey for almost 40 years to celebrate fashion, passion, self-employment, fun, love and community. Today, we are present in 35 countries with more than 700 stores, an online presence and more than 3 million fans on social networks. Show us how #UNSTOPPABLE you are! Branch Manager / Store Manager (f/m/d) Your Contribution to Our Common Success
• As a branch manager, you lead and train your team for company success
• Together with your team, you ensure the optimal customer service
• You are responsible for achieving the planned turnover
• You are responsible for compliance with the security measures in the shop
• You ensure the optimal goods management and the clean look of your store
• Your team wins new customers with your help and you maintain existing customer relationships
• You act as a role model and can motivate your team That draws you out
• A successfully completed commercial basic training in retail
• You bring 1-2 years of professional experience as a retail executive
• Organizational, planning and communication skills are among your strengths
• You have very good knowledge of German, every other language is an advantage
• You are fashion conscious, creative and 100% sales – as well as customer-oriented
• Fashion is your great passion and you inspire yourself for the latest trends
• You are proud of your well-groomed appearance
• Stay in a fast-paced environment You are always calm and flexible Your Advantages in Us
• We promote professional development and offer varied career opportunities
• Varied activity in a dynamic, open and team-oriented corporate culture
• Attractive employee discounts (50%)
• A working environment where fashion and fun at work are paramount
• International work experience
• Occupational pension provision
• Minimum 30 days of leave
• Basic salary and bonus possibilities Are you also UNSTOPPABLE and want to be part of our unprecedented fashion story in our unstoppable TALLY family? Then share your individual talent with us and apply now to Team HR Recruitment

jobs.title: Senior Denim Designer
jobs.description:
Senior Denim Designer

We're here to make you feel sexy, empowered & UNSTOPPABLE.

Founded in 1984, TALLY WEiJL has been on a crazy journey to celebrate fashion, independence, fun, love, & community for close to 40 years.

Today we’re present in 7 markets with about 400 stores, online presence, and 3m+ fans across social channels.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Denim Designer to lead the creative development of our denim category, driving innovation, product excellence, and commercial success.

This role reports directly to the Head of Product and plays a key role in shaping the denim vision in line with brand identity, customer needs, and market trends.

Your 
• Responsibilities

Lead the design and development of the denim collections, ensuring alignment with brand DNA, seasonal direction, and commercial targets.

Define key trends, washes, fits, fabrics, and detailing for the denim category, bringing a strong point of view and product vision.

Collaborate closely with Product, Buying, and Technical teams to ensure a seamless product development process from concept to final production.

Drive research and inspiration for denim, including fabrics, laundries, treatments, and innovations.

Oversee fittings and ensure the highest standards of fit, quality, and consistency across the category.

Develop and manage detailed technical packs, ensuring accuracy and clarity for suppliers.

Build strong relationships with suppliers, mills, and laundries to ensure innovation, quality, and timely delivery.

Monitor market trends, competitors, and customer feedback to continuously evolve the denim offering.

Support and mentor junior designers, fostering a collaborative and high-performing team environment.

Ensure all developments are delivered on time and in line with the critical path.

Your 
• Profile

Strong fashion sensitivity with a deep passion for denim product.

Proven experience in Denim Design, ideally at senior level.

Strong knowledge of denim fabrics, washes, fits, and production processes.

Solid commercial mindset with the ability to translate trends into best-selling products.

Strong technical design skills and attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills across cross-functional teams.

Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

What We Offer

· experience in a fast-growing digital environment

· Young, diverse, and international

· Competitive remuneration

· Transportaion from home to work

· Centrally located in the heart of Basel

· 50% Discount on our TALLY Collection

· Relocation Support if needed

· 25 to 28 days of annual holiday

Would you like to become a part of our fashion story and an enthusiastic member of our TALLY Family? Then share your individual talent with us and send us your application! Or contact directly our Talent Acquisition Business Partner at c.barone@tally-weijl.com.

descriptionByLocale.it: Senior Denim Designer Siamo qui per farti sentire sexy, potenziato e ONUSTOPPABLE. Fondato nel 1984, TALLY WEiJL è stato in un viaggio folle per celebrare moda, indipendenza, divertimento, amore e comunità per quasi 40 anni. Oggi siamo presenti in 7 mercati con circa 400 negozi, presenza online e 3m+ fan attraverso i canali sociali. Siamo alla ricerca di un Senior Denim Designer per condurre lo sviluppo creativo della nostra categoria denim, l'innovazione di guida, l'eccellenza del prodotto e il successo commerciale. Questo ruolo si riferisce direttamente al Capo Prodotto e svolge un ruolo chiave nella modellazione della visione denim in linea con l'identità del marchio, le esigenze del cliente e le tendenze del mercato. Le tue responsabilità conducono il design e lo sviluppo delle collezioni denim, garantendo l'allineamento con il DNA del marchio, la direzione stagionale e gli obiettivi commerciali. Definire le tendenze chiave, lava, si adatta, tessuti e dettagli per la categoria denim, portando un punto di vista forte e la visione del prodotto. Collaborare a stretto contatto con i team di prodotto, acquisto e tecnico per garantire un processo di sviluppo del prodotto senza soluzione di continuità dal concept alla produzione finale. Guida la ricerca e l'ispirazione per il denim, tra cui tessuti, lavanderie, trattamenti e innovazioni. Superare i raccordi e garantire i più elevati standard di vestibilità, qualità e coerenza in tutta la categoria. Sviluppare e gestire pacchetti tecnici dettagliati, garantendo precisione e chiarezza per i fornitori. Costruire relazioni forti con fornitori, mulini e lavanderie per garantire innovazione, qualità e consegna tempestiva. Monitorare le tendenze del mercato, i concorrenti e il feedback dei clienti per evolvere continuamente l'offerta denim. Supporto e mentore junior designer, promuovendo un ambiente di team collaborativo e altamente performante. Assicurarsi che tutti gli sviluppi siano consegnati in tempo e in linea con il percorso critico. Profilo Forte sensibilità alla moda con una profonda passione per il prodotto denim. Esperienza dimostrata in Denim Design, idealmente a livello senior. Forte conoscenza dei tessuti denim, lava, si adatta e processi produttivi. Solid mentalità commerciale con la capacità di tradurre le tendenze in prodotti best-seller. Forte capacità di progettazione tecnica e attenzione ai dettagli. Capacità di gestire più progetti in un ambiente frenetico. Ottima capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione tra team interfunzionali. Fluente in inglese; lingue aggiuntive sono un plus. Quindi condividere il vostro talento individuale con noi e inviarci la vostra applicazione! Oppure contatta direttamente il nostro Talent Acquisition Business Partner presso c.barone@tally-weijl.com.

jobs.title: Group Controller & Treasury
jobs.description:
We're here to make you feel sexy, empowered & UNSTOPPABLE.

Founded in 1984, TALLY WEiJL has been on a crazy journey to celebrate fashion, independence, fun, love, & community for close to 40 years.

Today we’re present in 35 markets with about 400 stores, online presence, and 3m+ fans across social channels.

Group Controller & Treasury Manager

Location: Basel, Switzerland
On-site: Monday to Friday

About the Role

We are looking for a Group Controller & Treasury Manager to lead our Finance operations and ensure the smooth running of all controlling and treasury activities at group level. This is a key, hands-on leadership role that combines financial control, cash management, and business partnering.The ideal candidate is a highly analytical and business-minded finance professional with strong treasury knowledge and proven experience managing a small finance team in an international retail environment.

Your 
• Responsibilities

· - Oversee all financial controlling activities, including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and management reporting.

· - Lead treasury operations, ensuring effective cash flow management, liquidity planning, and bank relationships.

· - Prepare consolidated group financial statements and monthly reporting packages.

· - Monitor KPIs and support management with data-driven insights to guide strategic decisions.

· - Manage and coach a small team within the finance department.

· - Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure financial accuracy, efficiency, and compliance.

· - Develop and maintain internal controls and financial processes to safeguard company assets.

· - Coordinate with external auditors, tax advisors, and financial institutions.

· - Contribute to strategic planning by providing actionable financial analysis and business recommendations.

Your 
• Profile

· - Proven experience in controlling and treasury within an international company (ideally retail or fashion).

· - Strong understanding of financial reporting, liquidity management, and forecasting.

· - Excellent command of accounting principles (Swiss GAAP / IFRS a plus).

· - Strategic mindset with a hands-on approach.

· - Strong leadership, communication, and influencing skills.

· - Highly organized, analytical, and detail-oriented.

· - Advanced Excel skills and experience with ERP systems (SAP)

· - Fluent in English (German or French a plus).

What We Offer

· - A key leadership role in a dynamic, international fashion company.

· - Direct impact on financial performance and strategic direction.

· - An empowering and collaborative culture in our Basel headquarters.

· - Competitive compensation and benefits package.

· - Forte comprensione del reporting finanziario, la gestione della liquidità e la previsione.

· - Comando eccellente dei principi contabili (Swiss GAAP / IFRS a plus).

· - mentalità strategica con un approccio pratico.

· - Forte leadership, comunicazione e capacità di influenzare.

· - Altamente organizzato, analitico e orientato al dettaglio.

· - Avanzate competenze di Excel e esperienza con i sistemi ERP (SAP)

· - Fluente in inglese (tedesco o francese un plus).

Cosa offriamo

· - Un ruolo chiave di leadership in una società di moda dinamica e internazionale.

Group Controller und Treasury Manager

Wir suchen einen Group Controller & Treasury Manager, der unsere Finanzgeschäfte leitet und den reibungslosen Ablauf aller Controlling- und Treasury-Aktivitäten auf Gruppenebene sicherstellt. • Zuständigkeiten

Leiten Sie Treasury-Operationen, um ein effektives Cashflow-Management, Liquiditätsplanung und Bankbeziehungen zu gewährleisten.

· Bereiten Sie konsolidierte Konzernabschlüsse und monatliche Berichtspakete vor.

• Überwachen Sie KPIs und unterstützen Sie das Management mit datengesteuerten Erkenntnissen, um strategische Entscheidungen zu treffen.

· - Verwalten und coachen Sie ein kleines Team in der Finanzabteilung.

· Partnerschaft mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams, um finanzielle Genauigkeit, Effizienz und Compliance zu gewährleisten.

Entwicklung und Aufrechterhaltung interner Kontrollen und Finanzprozesse zum Schutz der Vermögenswerte des Unternehmens.

- Koordination mit externen Wirtschaftsprüfern, Steuerberatern und Finanzinstituten.

Beitrag zur strategischen Planung durch umsetzbare Finanzanalysen und Geschäftsempfehlungen.

- Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Controlling und Treasury innerhalb eines internationalen Unternehmens (idealerweise Einzelhandel oder Mode).

· Ausgezeichnete Beherrschung der Rechnungslegungsgrundsätze (Schweizer GAAP / IFRS a plus).

· - Strategische Denkweise mit einem praktischen Ansatz.

Starke Führung, Kommunikation und beeinflussende Fähigkeiten.

Hoch organisiert, analytisch und detailorientiert.

Erweiterte Excel-Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen mit ERP-Systemen (SAP)

· - fließend in Englisch (Deutsch oder Französisch ein Plus).

Was wir anbieten

· Eine wichtige Führungsrolle in einem dynamischen, internationalen Modeunternehmen.

• Direkte Auswirkungen auf die finanzielle Performance und die strategische Ausrichtung.

· Eine stärkende und kollaborative Kultur in unserem Hauptsitz in Basel.

Contrôleur de groupe et gestionnaire de trésorerie

Sur place: du lundi au vendredi

À propos du rôle

Nous recherchons un contrôleur de groupe et un gestionnaire de trésorerie pour diriger nos opérations financières et assurer le bon fonctionnement de toutes les activités de contrôle et de trésorerie au niveau du groupe. Il s'agit d'un rôle clé de leadership pratique qui combine le contrôle financier, la gestion de la trésorerie et les partenariats d'affaires. Le candidat idéal est un professionnel de la finance hautement analytique et d'esprit d'entreprise avec une solide connaissance de la trésorerie et une expérience éprouvée de la gestion d'une petite équipe de finance dans un environnement de détail international.

Votre
• Responsabilités

· - Surveiller toutes les activités de contrôle financier, y compris la budgétisation, les prévisions, l'analyse des écarts et les rapports de gestion.

· - Diriger les opérations de trésorerie, assurer une gestion efficace des flux de trésorerie, la planification de la liquidité et les relations bancaires.

· - Préparer des états financiers consolidés et des trousses de rapports mensuels.

· - Surveiller les ICR et appuyer la gestion avec des idées fondées sur les données pour guider les décisions stratégiques.

· - Gérer et entraîner une petite équipe au sein du département des finances.

· - Partenaire avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour assurer l'exactitude, l'efficacité et la conformité financières.

· - Élaborer et maintenir des contrôles internes et des processus financiers pour protéger les actifs de l'entreprise.

· - Coordonner avec les vérificateurs externes, les conseillers fiscaux et les institutions financières.

· - Contribuer à la planification stratégique en fournissant une analyse financière pratique et des recommandations opérationnelles.

Votre
• Profil

· - Expérience éprouvée en matière de contrôle et de trésorerie au sein d'une entreprise internationale (idéalement de détail ou de mode).

· - Une bonne compréhension de l'information financière, de la gestion de la liquidité et des prévisions.

· - Excellente maîtrise des principes comptables (PCGR suisses / IFRS a plus).

· - Un état d'esprit stratégique avec une approche pratique.

· - Un leadership, une communication et des compétences influentes.

· - Très organisé, analytique et axé sur les détails.

· - Compétences Excel avancées et expérience avec les systèmes ERP (SAP)

· - Fluent en anglais (allemand ou français a plus).

Ce que nous offrons

· - Un rôle de leadership clé dans une entreprise de mode dynamique et internationale.

· - Incidence directe sur le rendement financier et l'orientation stratégique.

· - Une culture d'autonomisation et de collaboration au siège de Bâle.

· - Compensation et avantages concurrentiels.

jobs.description:
We're here to make you feel sexy, empowered & UNSTOPPABLE.

Founded in 1984, Tally Weijl has been on a crazy journey to celebrate fashion, independence, fun, love, & community for close to 40 years.

Today we’re present in 35 markets with over 450+ stores, online presence, and 3m+ fans across social channels.

Show us how #UNSTOPPABLE you are!

Fitting Model (Part-Time, 2 Days a Week)

Availability - Long Term

Location: Basel, Switzerland

Casting call ! We are looking for dedicated Fitting Models to join our team on a long-term basis.

This is a crucial role in our design and production process, as you will serve as the foundation for creating and adapting all our garments and sizes.

What Makes This Role Unique?

As a Fitting Model, you will be at the core of our creative process. Every piece of clothing we design will be tailored to your measurements, making you the blueprint for our collection. Your body will ensure that every garment fits perfectly before it goes into production.

This is not a runway or photoshoot modeling position—your role will be pivotal in bringing our designs to life and ensuring our brand maintains the highest standards in fit and quality.

Key Requirements:

• Availability: 2 days per week

• Location: Must be based in or able to commute to Basel

• Measurements:

• Height: 170 cm

• Chest: 86 cm

• Waist: 66 cm

• Hip: 94 cm

• Bicep: 27 cm

• Thigh: 53 cm

What We’re Looking For:

• Reliability, professionalism, and a long-term commitment to the role.

• An understanding of the importance of precision and consistency in this role.

• Comfort with regular measurements and fittings, as this will be a hands-on position with our design team.

If this sounds like you, please send you measurements and full body photos to c.barone@tally-weijl.com

jobs.title: (Senior or Pro) Merchandise Planner

Today we’re present in 35 markets with about 400 stores, online presence, and 3m+ fans across social channels.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly analytical and business-driven (Senior) Merchandise Planner to drive financial planning, assortment strategies and inventory management across multiple product categories.

Partnering closely with Buying, Product and Retail teams, you will play a key role in maximizing sales, margin and stock productivity while ensuring the right products are available at the right time, in the right quantities and in the right markets.

Your 
• Responsibilities

· Develop and manage seasonal and in-season merchandise financial plans, budgets and forecasts

· Own category performance analysis, identifying opportunities and risks to drive sales and profitability

· Lead Open To Buy (OTB) planning and inventory management to ensure optimal stock levels

· Build assortment and option plans in partnership with Buyers, balancing commercial opportunities and financial targets

· Analyze sales, stock, margin and markdown performance, providing actionable recommendations

· Monitor weekly trading performance and proactively recommend actions to improve results

· Drive allocation and replenishment strategies to maximize sell-through and stock productivity

· Support pricing, promotional and markdown strategies to optimize profitability

· Prepare and present business reviews, forecasts and strategic recommendations to senior stakeholders

· Collaborate closely with Buying, Retail, Supply Chain and Finance teams to support business objectives

· Contribute to the continuous improvement of planning tools, processes and reporting

Your 
• Profile

· Minimum 3-4 years of experience in Merchandise Planning, Allocation, Demand Planning or a similar analytical retail function

· Strong commercial awareness combined with excellent analytical and numerical skills

· Advanced Excel skills; SAP/BW or similar planning systems are a strong advantage

· Experience managing OTB, forecasting and inventory planning

· Ability to interpret complex data and translate insights into commercial actions

· Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

· Proactive, solution-oriented and collaborative mindset

· Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

· Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus

What We Offer

· A dynamic, international and fast-paced working environment

· The opportunity to have a direct impact on business performance and strategic decision-making

· Exposure to senior stakeholders and cross-functional collaboration

· Competitive compensation and benefits package
